versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the patent asset grading skill.
- Enables batch evaluation (up to 50 patents) by entering publication/application numbers.
- Automatically retrieves patent data from PatSnap MCP and identifies industry by IPC code.
- Scores patents on five dimensions with industry-specific weighting: technical relevance, claim strength, market coverage, remaining protection, and citation/cross-value.
- Outputs results as structured Excel or Word reports with clear grading and recommendations.
- Includes correction factors for SEP, litigation, and risk status; requires MCP configuration for full functionality.
